contradicted_by_a_later_filing.note: Viacom filed never-paid statements for eight years and then began paying. A ticker-level sourced zero would have zero-filled 2003 onwards, which is why the zero carries a date bound and this contradiction is recorded beside it. The dividends themselves are not wired: VIA is never selected in any scenario, so sourcing them would move nothing and is left to a later pass.
contradicted_by_a_later_filing.quoted_sentence: Viacom Inc.'s Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $.06 per share on its common stock during the third and fourth quarters of 2003.
